title: WorldEdit
what: Build tools for operators: fill, copy, paste and undo big areas in seconds.
steps: In the game, type //wand to get a wooden axe. Left-click one corner, right-click the other.
//set stone fills the area, //copy and //paste copy it, //undo takes the last change back.
Big edits can freeze a small server for a moment, so try small areas first.
Only players can select areas, so the buttons here are for checking the plugin.
